title: @inth/sdk-core: Headless JavaScript cookie consent engine
description: The headless JavaScript cookie consent engine behind every Inth adapter. It resolves consent policies for GDPR and other privacy laws, stores choices, and holds back configured scripts, iframes, and network requests that the visitor's policy and choices do not allow. Use it to build your own consent UI or to connect a framework that has no Inth adapter.
features: Bring your own UI: render from a consent snapshot, and Inth keeps state, storage, and policy resolution
Control configured scripts, iframes, and network requests with category permissions from the resolved policy
Policies decide who sees a banner: opt-in for visitors in the EU, opt-out for some US states, or rules that you write
Google Consent Mode v2, IAB TCF 2.4, and Global Privacy Control support
Creating a runtime has no side effects, so the module is safe to import on the server
Vendor loaders for Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, PostHog, and more through @inth/integrations
prerequisites: An [Inth project](https://inth.com) (free sign-up), or `testing()` for development and tests
usage: Create one runtime for the page with `createConsentRuntime` and a mode such as `hosted()`
Render your banner from `runtime.kernel.getSnapshot()` and update it from `runtime.kernel.subscribe()`
Record choices with `runtime.kernel.commands.save('all')`, `save('none')`, or an object such as `{ measurement: true }`
For the full walkthrough, see the [headless runtime guide](https://inth.com/docs/frameworks/javascript/headless)

customSections.Related Packages:
- [@inth/sdk](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@inth/sdk): this engine with a stock banner and preference dialog for plain JavaScript and script-tag sites
- [@inth/integrations](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@inth/integrations): consent-aware analytics, tag manager, pixel, and widget loaders
